### Happiness Honors the King
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/happiness-honors-the-king
Passage: 1 Kings 10:8
Points:
- The Queen of Sheba’s highest praise for Solomon was the genuine happiness of his servants and people.
- Worldly rulers can amass great wealth or enforce compliance, but authentic joy cannot be coerced.
- A godly leader’s highest glory is found in the thriving, settled satisfaction of those under their care.
- Solomon's earthly reign was flawed and temporary, pointing forward to the ultimate rule of Jesus Christ.
- Christ is most honored in His subjects when His people find their deepest joy and satisfaction in Him.

### 3 Important Lessons from the Queen of Sheba and Solomon
Author: Jennifer Heeren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/important-lessons-from-the-queen-of-sheba-and-solomon.html
Passage: 1 Kings 10:1-13
Points:
- Believers should seek God's wisdom and discernment daily rather than relying on human understanding.
- Skepticism and jealousy often tempt us when others succeed, so we must guard against comparison.
- Witnessing excellence and order should lead us to praise God as the true source of every blessing.
- The Queen of Sheba recognized that God placed Solomon on the throne to execute justice and righteousness.
- While material prosperity is temporary, eternal spiritual blessings in Christ should be treasured above all.
